model.name: R19.33: Detail drawer close affordance stays sticky in view, never scrolls away.
model.description: BUG: the detail drawer's close affordance (nudge handle / X button) scrolls out of view when the user scrolls down in the detail content. FIX: the close affordance MUST be position:sticky or position:fixed relative to the drawer viewport so it remains visible and tappable regardless of content scroll position. Implementation: the (X) close button (app.css:278/280 area) must STAY ON TOP ALWAYS — sticky above the scrolling body. Tron re-confirmed via planner relay 2026-06-11.
model.tronQuote:
